description.short: AI assistant that answers questions from your team's KM, Google Docs, and Notion.
description.full: A Microsoft Teams bot that searches your internal knowledge sources (Wiki.js, Google Docs, Notion) and answers questions in natural language. Also supports personal notes, reminders, and publishing notes back to the KB.

commands.title: #note
commands.description: Save a quick note (draft for later publishing)

commands.title: #remind
commands.description: Add a reminder (supports dates like 4/15 or 'tomorrow 2pm')

commands.title: #publish
commands.description: Publish a note to KM or Google Docs

commands.title: #edit
commands.description: Edit a KB document (KM / Google Docs / Notion)

commands.title: #append
commands.description: Append content to an existing KB document
